seeds.why: Pre-#1258 regrain_step: no isolation level is refused, so a hand swap step in a REPEATABLE READ transaction reconciles and counts the captured delta through the transaction's first snapshot, misses a writer's UPDATE and DELETE committed after it, and drops the source with both unapplied (row 10 reverted, row 30 back); and a maintain tick in a session whose default_transaction_isolation is REPEATABLE READ copies instead of logging the refusal. One site, the step's call. tests/329 parts C and D catch it.
